name: SciShow Kids
classes: About 4 to 10 years (third-party guides; channel page did not load)

curriculum.summary: SciShow Kids is a science channel for young children, hosted by Jessi and her robot rat Squeaks, who answer children's questions and explain science in simple terms. Third-party guides place it at roughly ages 4 to 10. One summary of Wikipedia's SciShow entry says the Kids channel went on hiatus in late 2018; its current posting status was not confirmed.

fees_note: Free to watch on YouTube (per third-party guides).
how_to_check: Check the upload dates on the channel before relying on it for new episodes.
